summary: A 60-ft steel fire tower on Crescent Lake NWR, standing and registered in August 2026; the 1935 build date conflicts with other sources.

events.note: Register gives 1935 for a 60-foot steel tower. Not reconciled with the early-1940s CCC date the register quotes from USFWS, or with a 1937 newspaper report of a WPA 100-foot tower at the refuge
Registered August 9, 2026 as US 1844, NE 2; nominated by Admin

evidence.supports: same 1935 date and 60-foot height on West Lookouts
USFWS quote: two towers built early 1940s by CCC
evidence.quote: The fire tower is one of two such structures built on the Refuge in the early 1940's by the Civilian Conservation Corps.

evidence.supports: towers no longer used for fire observation, now serve wildlife
evidence.quote: Although the towers are no longer used for fire observation, they are serving wildlife.
Administered by U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
Crescent Lake North Garden 41.75599 -102.40339 Tower Standing

evidence.supports: newspaper item dated January 31, 1937 (quoted on south page): WPA work at the Garden county refuge began in 1936
evidence.quote: January 31, 1937: "At the Garden county refuge, work was started by the WPA in 1936

evidence.supports: 100-foot steel lookout tower built at the refuge; the page does not name which tower
evidence.quote: They built a 100 foot steel lookout tower

evidence.supports: refuge protected in 1931 for wetlands, migratory birds and other animals
evidence.quote: Crescent Lake NWR was protected in 1931 to ensure the wetlands would continue to be protected, providing migratory bird species and other animals a safe haven.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Not resolved. The north register page gives 1935 for a 60-foot tower and quotes USFWS placing the two refuge towers in the early 1940s by the CCC. The south register page quotes a January 1937 newspaper describing a WPA-built 100-foot tower and assigns it to the south site. The story reports all three without choosing one.

notes_for_editor: Build date is the open question. 1935 (register and West Lookouts, which may share a source) conflicts with the USFWS early-1940s CCC statement quoted on the register and with the 1937 WPA newspaper item quoted on the south page. Needs a primary source (refuge history, USFWS or Nebraska State Historical Society) before the built event is firmed up. Height 18.3 m is our conversion of 60 ft. Nominator is listed as 'Admin' on the register page. A Living New Deal search snippet reportedly says the WPA built 'the fire tower' at the headquarters site; not used because that page returned 403. Access and visit rules not confirmed; the FWS visit page was not read. Read budget exceeded: several reads returned 403 or the wrong page.
